description: Set which days the person is free (YYYY-MM-DD, today up to 2 years ahead). mode: "replace" (default) sets exactly these days, "add" / "remove" change them. Only with the user's confirmation. After the requested changes, call get_plan for this same plan before reporting the saved result.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: set_availability
title: Set available days
